messages.content:

For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. - Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise

Just then, I looked up, and there was Mary Magdalene, standing in the cave, saying he has risen, a bittersweet moment.

output.surprise: While in the bathroom, chaos erupted on the TV, getting louder and louder! I washed my hands and dashed to the remote, exclaiming ``Jesus Christ!'' Just then, I looked up in shock as Mary Magdalene stood in the cave, saying he has risen!
output.disgust: While in the bathroom, there was this awful chaos on the TV, growing louder and louder... I washed my hands and hurried to the remote, saying ``Jesus Christ'' in disbelief. Just then, I looked up, and there was Mary Magdalene in the cave, saying he has risen, and it felt just so out of place.
